content.text:
Yes—the branch changed how text looks.

- **Default page text became near-black** instead of the previous muted purple-gray (`#453C52`). That applies across page content in [AppRouter.tsx:189](/Users/bodhishthomas/code/care_fe/src/Routers/AppRouter.tsx:189), making text appear heavier.
- **Encounter section headings became smaller, bold, uppercase text** in [EncounterAccordionLayout.tsx:65](/Users/bodhishthomas/code/care_fe/src/components/Patient/EncounterAccordionLayout.tsx:65).
- Sidebar typography also changed with the workspace redesign.

Font loading itself looks healthy: Figtree loads, and weights resolve correctly to 400/500/600/700.

The broad text-color override is the likely unintended regression. I’d restore the original content color while keeping the new navigation styling scoped to navigation. No code changed yet.
I’ll restore the original page text color and keep the new navigation styling scoped to the navigation.
